subject.title: fix: preserve embedded prompt caching across room events and native Responses

question: Should denied room-event, non-owner, and unknown-sender turns retain model-visible schemas for computer, cron, gateway, and nodes when hard runtime gates block execution?
rationale: Tests can establish fail-closed execution, but only maintainers can accept capability disclosure and runtime wrappers as the permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Keep schemas visible with hard gates
options.body: Approve the cache-stable catalogue after exact-head embedded and CLI/MCP denial proof confirms every execution path remains fail-closed.

options.title: Split protected-schema visibility
options.body: Land lower-risk delivery and continuation work separately while retaining hidden protected schemas until a narrower policy is approved.
